name: Paint
description: Annotate photos inside Mattermost: draw, add arrows, text and emoji stickers, then send the edited copy back as a thread reply.

settings_schema.header:
Paint lets people annotate photos that have been shared in a channel and send the edited copy back as a thread reply.

On the web and desktop apps a pencil button appears on images. The official mobile apps cannot render plugin interfaces, so mobile users type `/paint` in a channel and follow the private link they get back.

settings.display_name: Pencil button in the image preview
settings.help_text: Adds a pencil button to the full-screen image preview on web and desktop. Turn this off if you would rather keep Mattermost's stock preview; the 'Annotate image' item in each attachment's ··· menu keeps working either way.
How long a link handed out by /paint stays usable. Links are single-user and are invalidated once the edited image is sent.
Edited images larger than this are rejected. Must also be within the server's own file size limit.
Number of recent posts in the channel that /paint scans for images.
